title: Catch-Up and Come Home: Economic Convergence and Return Migration
abstract: arXiv:2609.31236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The return migration of skilled workers provides origin countries many important benefits. The likelihood of return migration is thought to depend on relative economic opportunities, but quantitative evidence of its relative importance remains limited. Here we measure return migration rates using the public profiles of software developers on GitHub, geocoded across ten waves between 2012 and 2026, in a panel containing more than 270,000 international movers. Within five years of departure, 8.8% of movers have returned. Origin-country rates range from under 1\% to 16\%. Hazard models with corridor fixed effects show that migrants whose home countries experience greater catch-up growth return at significantly higher rates. Immutable features of country pairs such as cultural or geographic distance do not explain the estimate. translated_title: 追赶与归乡：经济收敛与回流移民
translated_abstract: 技术工人的回流为原籍国带来许多重要益处。回流移民的可能性被认为取决于相对经济机会，但关于其相对重要性的定量证据仍然有限。本研究利用GitHub上软件开发者的公开档案来测量回流移民率，数据经地理编码，覆盖2012年至2026年间的十次观测，构建了一个包含超过27万名国际流动者的面板数据。在离开后的五年内，8.8%的流动者已经返回，原籍国的回流率从低于1%到16%不等。采用走廊固定效应的风险模型显示，那些母国经历更强追赶式经济增长的移民，其回流率显著更高，而国家对之间不可改变的特征（如文化或地理距离）无法解释这一结果。研究还利用IMF增长预测对未来的回流率进行了预测。
tldr: 本研究基于GitHub上27万多名软件开发者的面板数据，发现母国的经济追赶式增长是技术人才回流的关键驱动因素，并据此预测了各国未来的回流率。
en_tdlr: Using a panel of over 270,000 software developers from GitHub, this study finds that catch-up economic growth in migrants' home countries significantly increases skilled workers' return migration rates.
